$comment: Renamed off the `claude-` placeholder 2026-07-24 (CEO), clearing the trademark half of the
§12.4 gate. The doc's OTHER recorded objection stands and was accepted knowingly: `plugin-spec`
still reads as 'a specification for plugins', which is a different product. Cheap to change
again while the repo is private and unpublished; permanent the moment someone installs it.
`hooks` and `skills` keys REMOVED 2026-07-26. `hooks/hooks.json` and `skills/` are loaded by
convention; naming them here registers them a SECOND time, and Claude Code rejects the duplicate —
'Hook load failed: Duplicate hooks file detected' — which fails the whole hook load, so the plugin
installed with zero hooks. Found by running `claude --plugin-dir . plugin list`, which is the only
thing that reads this file. Nothing in the repo's own tests could have caught it.
name: plugin-spec
description: Builds a requirement source-of-truth out of your codebase and keeps it true after implementation: one truth, and every behaviour proven.
